Remarks

This partial struct contains rendering-oriented members for quads, including scaled drawing, vignette fills, chamfered corners, corner markers, masked outlines, and gapped outlines.

ContainsQuadPoint(Vector2, Vector2, Vector2, Vector2, Vector2)

Determines whether a point is contained within a quadrilateral defined by four vertices.

public static bool ContainsQuadPoint(Vector2 qA, Vector2 qB, Vector2 qC, Vector2 qD, Vector2 point)

Parameters

qA Vector2

First vertex of the quad (CCW order).

qB Vector2

Second vertex of the quad (CCW order).

qC Vector2

Third vertex of the quad (CCW order).

qD Vector2

Fourth vertex of the quad (CCW order).

point Vector2

The point to test.

Returns

bool

true if the point is inside the quad; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Uses the even-odd rule for point-in-polygon testing. This rule is a common algorithm to determine if a point is inside a polygon: you draw a ray from the point and count how many times it crosses the polygon's edges. If the number of crossings is odd, the point is inside; if even, it's outside. This method is robust for convex and concave polygons, including quadrilaterals.

DrawChamferedCornersLines(float, ColorRgba, float)

Draws the outline of a quad with equally chamfered corners using the specified line thickness.

public void DrawChamferedCornersLines(float lineThickness, ColorRgba color, float cornerLength)

Parameters

lineThickness float

The thickness of the outline. If less than or equal to zero, the chamfered quad is filled instead of outlined.

color ColorRgba

The color used to draw the outline.

cornerLength float

The chamfer length applied uniformly to all four corners. If less than or equal to zero, the regular quad outline is drawn.

Remarks

The chamfer length and line thickness are clamped to the quad's minimum half-size to avoid invalid geometry. Internally, this method builds inner and outer chamfer polygons and triangulates the outline area.

DrawChamferedCornersLines(float, ColorRgba, float, float)

Draws the outline of a quad with chamfered corners using separate horizontal and vertical chamfer lengths.

public void DrawChamferedCornersLines(float lineThickness, ColorRgba color, float cornerLengthHorizontal, float cornerLengthVertical)

Parameters

lineThickness float

The thickness of the outline. If less than or equal to zero, the chamfered quad is filled instead of outlined.

color ColorRgba

The color used to draw the outline.

cornerLengthHorizontal float

The chamfer length measured along horizontal edges. If less than or equal to zero while the vertical value is positive, the method falls back to the uniform chamfer overload using the vertical value.

cornerLengthVertical float

The chamfer length measured along vertical edges. If less than or equal to zero while the horizontal value is positive, the method falls back to the uniform chamfer overload using the horizontal value.

Remarks

When both chamfer lengths are effectively equal, this method forwards to the single-length overload. Chamfer lengths are clamped against the corresponding quad half-dimensions, and line thickness is clamped against the minimum half-size of the quad.

Negative corner values are clamped to zero. Each corner length is also clamped to the quad's minimum half-size before geometry is generated. If all corner lengths are zero, the method falls back to drawing a regular quad outline.

DrawChamferedCornersLinesRelative(float, ColorRgba, float)

Draws the outline of a quad with uniformly chamfered corners specified as a relative factor of the quad size.

public void DrawChamferedCornersLinesRelative(float lineThickness, ColorRgba color, float cornerLengthFactor)

Parameters

lineThickness float

The thickness of the outline. If less than or equal to zero, the filled chamfered quad is drawn instead.

color ColorRgba

The color used to draw the outline.

cornerLengthFactor float

A normalized factor in the range [0, 1] that determines the chamfer amount relative to the quad half-size.

Remarks

The factor is clamped to the range [0, 1]. The resulting horizontal and vertical chamfer lengths are derived from half the quad width and half the quad height respectively.

lineThickness float

cornerLengthFactorHorizontal float

A normalized factor in the range [0, 1] that scales the chamfer amount relative to half the quad width.

cornerLengthFactorVertical float

A normalized factor in the range [0, 1] that scales the chamfer amount relative to half the quad height.

Remarks

Both factors are clamped independently to the range [0, 1] before being converted into absolute chamfer lengths.

DrawGappedOutline(float, LineDrawingInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo)

Draws a gapped outline for a quadrilateral, creating a dashed or segmented effect along the quad's perimeter.

public float DrawGappedOutline(float perimeter, LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, GappedOutlineDrawingInfo gapDrawingInfo)

Parameters

perimeter float

The total length of the quad's perimeter. If zero or negative, the method calculates it automatically. Providing a known length avoids redundant calculations and improves performance, especially for static segments.

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing how to draw the outline.

gapDrawingInfo GappedOutlineDrawingInfo

Parameters describing the gap configuration.

Returns

float

The perimeter of the quad if positive; otherwise, -1. If the shape does not change, the valid length can be reused in subsequent frames to avoid recalculating.

Remarks

  • If gapDrawingInfo.Gaps.Gaps is 0 or gapDrawingInfo.GapPerimeterPercentage.GapPerimeterPercentage is 0, the outline is drawn solid.
  • If gapDrawingInfo.GapPerimeterPercentage.GapPerimeterPercentage is 1 or greater, no outline is drawn.

Parameters

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

DrawScaled(ColorRgba, float, float, int)

Draws a quad with scaled sides based on a specific draw type.

public void DrawScaled(ColorRgba color, float sideScaleFactor, float sideScaleOrigin, int drawType)

Parameters

color ColorRgba

The color of the drawn shape.

sideScaleFactor float

The scale factor of the sides (0 to 1). If >= 1, the full quad is drawn. If <= 0, nothing is drawn.

sideScaleOrigin float

The origin point for scaling the sides (0 = start, 1 = end, 0.5 = center).

drawType int

The style of drawing:

  • 0: [Filled] Drawn as 6 filled triangles, effectively cutting off the corners.
  • 1: [Sides] Each side is connected to the quad's center.
  • 2: [Sides Inverse] The start of 1 side is connected to the end of the next side and is connected to the quad's center.

DrawVertices(float, ColorRgba, float)

Draws circles at each vertex of a Quad.

public void DrawVertices(float vertexRadius, ColorRgba color, float smoothness = 0.5)

Parameters

vertexRadius float

The radius of each vertex circle.

color ColorRgba

The color of the vertex circles.

smoothness float

The smoothness value (0-1). This controls the visual quality of the circle by inversely interpolating the current CircleSideLengthRange. A value of 0 uses the maximum side length (fewer sides, less smooth), while 1 uses the minimum side length (more sides, smoother). The resulting side length determines the number of polygon sides used to approximate the circle.

Remarks

Useful for visualizing or highlighting the corners of a quad.

ProjectShape(Polygon, Vector2, bool)

Projects the quad along a given vector and stores the convex hull in the provided Polygon.

public bool ProjectShape(Polygon result, Vector2 v, bool useBuffer = false)

Parameters

result Polygon

The Polygon instance to populate with the convex hull of the projected shape.

v Vector2

The vector along which to project the quad's vertices.

useBuffer bool

true to reuse the internal points buffer and avoid a temporary allocation; false to allocate a new temporary buffer. Set this to false when calling from parallel or multi-threaded code, since the internal buffer is shared and not thread-safe.

Returns

bool

true if the projection vector is non-zero and the polygon was populated; otherwise, false.

ProjectShape(Vector2, bool)

Projects the quad along a given vector and returns the convex hull as a polygon.

Parameters

v Vector2

The vector along which to project the quad's vertices.

useBuffer bool

true to reuse the internal points buffer and avoid a temporary allocation; false to allocate a new temporary buffer. Set this to false when calling from parallel or multi-threaded code, since the internal buffer is shared and not thread-safe.

Returns

Polygon

A Polygon representing the convex hull of the projected shape, or null if the vector is zero.

Remarks

Useful for shadow or extrusion effects.
